description: Edits text and/or attachments of an existing comment. If `attached_files` is provided, it fully replaces the previous list — files not in the new list are deleted from storage.

file_name.description: Display name of the file as it will appear in the comment.

url.description: Public URL of a previously uploaded attachment (returned by `incident_comment_upload_file` as `file_url`).

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: incident_comment_update
title: Update incident comment
